title: Linear Equations
summary: An equation of degree one in one variable is a linear equation; its general form is ax + b = 0 (a ≠ 0). The value of the variable that satisfies it is its solution (root): x = −b/a. To solve, do the same operation on both sides — add, subtract, multiply or divide — until the variable is alone. An expression such as 5x + 7 (with no '=' sign) is not an equation.

The general form is ax + by + c = 0, where a, b, c are real numbers and a, b are not both zero. In 5(2x − 4) + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0, expanding gives 13x + 4y − 27 = 0, so the coefficient of y is 4. An equation in one variable can be written in this form too: y = 3 is 0·x + 1·y − 3 = 0 (a = 0, b = 1, c = −3). Each solution is a pair (x, y); a point lies on the line if its coordinates satisfy the equation — e.g. (4, 3) does not lie on 3x + 7y = 27 because 12 + 21 = 33 ≠ 27.

The graph of a linear equation in two variables is a straight line. To draw it, find at least two (better three) solutions, plot them and join them. Put x = 0 to find where the line cuts the y-axis and y = 0 to find where it cuts the x-axis: 2x + 3y = 6 cuts the y-axis at (0, 2) and the x-axis at (3, 0). x = a is a line parallel to the y-axis; y = b is a line parallel to the x-axis.

For a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 drawn on the same graph: (i) intersecting lines — one (unique) solution, the point of intersection; this happens when a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂. (ii) Coincident lines — infinitely many solutions, when a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂. (iii) Parallel lines — no solution, when a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.

Substitution: find one variable from one equation (e.g. y = 7 − x) and put it in the other. Elimination: multiply the equations so that the coefficients of one variable become equal, then add or subtract to remove it, solve, and substitute back. Always check the answer in both equations.

Choose letters for the unknowns, turn each sentence into an equation, solve, and check that the answer makes sense. Common types: two numbers (sum and difference), ages ('3 years ago' means subtract 3 from each present age), digits (a two-digit number with tens digit x and units digit y is 10x + y; reversed it is 10y + x), cost of articles, rectangles (perimeter 2(l + b), area lb), and work (if a person finishes a job in m days, he does 1/m of it in a day).
mcq: Which of the following is NOT a linear equation?

mcq.work:
An equation must have an '=' sign joining two expressions.
2x + 3 = 7, x − y = 4 and 3x = 9 are equations of degree one.
5x + 7 is only an expression — it is not an equation at all.

mcq: Which of the following is NOT a linear equation?

mcq.work:
A linear equation has every variable with power 1.
In x + y² = 7 − 2x the term y² has degree 2, so it is not linear.

Multiply the first by 2 and the second by 3: 4x + 6y + 10 = 0 and 9x − 6y − 36 = 0.
Add: 13x − 26 = 0 ⇒ x = 2.
Then 2(2) + 3y + 5 = 0 ⇒ 3y = −9 ⇒ y = −3.
Check: 3(2) − 2(−3) − 12 = 6 + 6 − 12 = 0 ✓.

mcq: The graph of y = −3 is a line —

mcq.work:
On y = −3 every point has y-coordinate −3, e.g. (0, −3), (5, −3).
All the points are at the same height, so the line is parallel to the x-axis, 3 units below it.

mcq: The line 2x + 3y = 6 meets the y-axis at —

mcq.work:
On the y-axis x = 0.
2(0) + 3y = 6 ⇒ y = 2.
So the line meets the y-axis at (0, 2).

mcq: The coefficient of y in 5(2x − 4) + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0 is —

mcq.work:
Expand: 10x − 20 + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0 ⇒ 13x + 4y − 27 = 0.
The coefficient of y is 4.

mcq: The pair kx + 2y = 5 and 3x + y = 1 has no solution when k is —

mcq.work:
No solution means parallel lines: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂.
k/3 = 2/1 ⇒ k = 6.
Check c₁/c₂ = 5/1 = 5 ≠ 2, so the lines are parallel, not the same. k = 6.

mcq: If the difference of two numbers is 5 and the smaller is 36, the greater is —

mcq.work:
Let the greater be x and the smaller y: x − y = 5.
x − 36 = 5 ⇒ x = 41.

All three ratios are equal, so the lines coincide: infinitely many solutions.

objective: Match: (i) The coefficient of y in 5(2x − 4) + 3x + 4y − 7 = 0 is ____ (ii) When y = 3 is written as ax + by + c = 0, a is ____ — (A) 0 (B) 3 (C) 4

(i) Expanding: 13x + 4y − 27 = 0, so the coefficient of y is 4 → (C).
(ii) y = 3 is 0·x + 1·y − 3 = 0, so a = 0 → (A).
Write True or False: (i) The graph of 2x + 3y = 6 cuts the y-axis at (0, 2). (ii) The graph of x = 2 is a line parallel to the x-axis.

(i) True: x = 0 gives 3y = 6, y = 2.
(ii) False: on x = 2 every point has x = 2, so it is parallel to the y-axis.
Fill in the blanks: (i) 2x + 3y = 7 and (p − 1)x + (p + 2)y = 3p have infinitely many solutions when p = ____. (ii) kx + 2y = 5 and 3x + y = 1 have no solution when k = ____.
Write True or False: (i) The point (4, 3) lies on 3x + 7y = 27. (ii) The graph of y = −3 is parallel to the x-axis.

(i) False: 3(4) + 7(3) = 33 ≠ 27.
(ii) True: every point on it has y = −3.
'MATHSBOLA' — Fill in the blanks: (i) 'The difference of two numbers is 5' as an equation is ____. (ii) If the smaller number is 36, the greater is ____.

(i) Let the greater be x and the smaller y: x − y = 5.
(ii) x − 36 = 5 ⇒ x = 41.

vsa: 1 table and 3 chairs cost ₹3,000; 2 tables and 1 chair cost ₹3,750. Find the cost of a table and of a chair.

Let a table cost ₹t and a chair ₹c.
t + 3c = 3000 …(1); 2t + c = 3750 …(2).
From (1), t = 3000 − 3c. Put in (2): 6000 − 6c + c = 3750 ⇒ 5c = 2250 ⇒ c = 450.
t = 3000 − 1350 = 1650.
A table costs ₹1,650 and a chair ₹450.

The perimeter of a rectangular garden is 20 m and its length is 4 m more than its breadth. Find its length, breadth and area.

Let breadth = b, length = b + 4.
2(l + b) = 20 ⇒ (b + 4) + b = 10 ⇒ 2b = 6 ⇒ b = 3.
Length = 7 m, breadth = 3 m, area = 7 × 3 = 21 m².

For what value of k will 3x + y = 1 and (2k − 1)x + (k − 1)y = 2k + 1 have no solution?

No solution: 3/(2k − 1) = 1/(k − 1) ≠ 1/(2k + 1).
3(k − 1) = 2k − 1 ⇒ 3k − 3 = 2k − 1 ⇒ k = 2.
Check: 1/(k − 1) = 1 and 1/(2k + 1) = 1/5; they differ, so the lines are parallel. k = 2.

la: The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 11. If the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 less than the original. Find the number.

Let the tens digit be x and the units digit y; the number is 10x + y.
x + y = 11 …(1)
(10x + y) − (10y + x) = 27 ⇒ 9x − 9y = 27 ⇒ x − y = 3 …(2)
Add: 2x = 14 ⇒ x = 7; y = 4.
The number is 74. Check: 74 − 47 = 27 ✓.
2 men and 7 boys can do a piece of work in 4 days; 4 men and 4 boys can do it in 3 days. How long would one man alone, or one boy alone, take?

Let a man do 1/m and a boy 1/b of the work in a day; put u = 1/m, v = 1/b.
4 days: 4(2u + 7v) = 1 ⇒ 8u + 28v = 1 …(1)
3 days: 3(4u + 4v) = 1 ⇒ 12u + 12v = 1 …(2)
From (2): u = 1/12 − v. Put in (1): 8/12 − 8v + 28v = 1 ⇒ 20v = 1/3 ⇒ v = 1/60.
u = 1/12 − 1/60 = 4/60 = 1/15.
A man alone takes 15 days and a boy alone 60 days.
Three years ago Sunil was four times as old as his sister Shruti. Five years from now he will be twice her age. Find their present ages, and the father's present age if he was 25 when Sunil was born.

Let Sunil be S and Shruti R years old now.
S − 3 = 4(R − 3) ⇒ S = 4R − 9 …(1)
S + 5 = 2(R + 5) ⇒ S = 2R + 5 …(2)
4R − 9 = 2R + 5 ⇒ 2R = 14 ⇒ R = 7; S = 19.
Father = 19 + 25 = 44 years.
Sunil 19, Shruti 7, father 44.
